evidence.note: Every Q3 on-time figure sits beside its Q2 prior-period figure and a Change (points) column: 12 Cross-town 85% to 70% (-14), 14 Cross-town 85% to 74% (-11), other six median 87% to 87% (under 1), Network 86% to 81% (-5).
A Network row gives a baseline against which the diverted routes and the other six can be judged.
Caption gives the range (85-90% in Q3, each within 2 points of Q2) and flags a data-coverage caveat: Route 7 Q3 covers 9 of 13 weeks.
Title states the 85%-90% range rather than a single bare figure.
Insight overlay adds no new numbers; it interprets the comparison already shown.

rationale: Each key quantity is shown against the prior quarter, a computed change and a network baseline, with a range and a coverage caveat for the uncertain figure. No figure stands bare; the absence of a target is not needed when prior-period comparison and baseline let the audience judge good or bad.
